description.text: The sixth Sword & Shield set, released on 18 June 2021 with 233 cards: 198 and 35 secret rares. It draws on The Crown Tundra expansion of the games, with Ice Rider Calyrex VMAX and Shadow Rider Calyrex VMAX and the Galarian forms of Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres, and it carries on the Single Strike and Rapid Strike cards.
